scope.scope: Auxiliary diagnostic correction specified after the first held-out original/base controls, before any completed trained held-out case was inspected. Not a replacement pre-registered primary endpoint.
scope.reason: The frozen recognition diagnostic appends EOS to a fact fragment and separately tokenizes the middle-of-answer boundary. That can penalize an otherwise correct continuation and weaken positive controls.
scope.scoring: Use canonical QA prompt tokenization as training; jointly tokenize gold-answer-prefix plus candidate fact with offsets. Score only tokens whose offsets intersect the candidate fact, without an EOS token. Include boundary-spanning answer tokens. Prefix must not contain the tested fact.
scope.cohort: All24selected frozen final checkpoints; all three original/base controls. No cherry-picking.
scope.metrics: Type-matched top-choice accuracy with original-correct/base-incorrect controls; also true-fact log-probability vs base+0.1 on original-elevated facts. Report raw denominators and probabilities.
no_changes: No training source or frozen scorer change
No checkpoint or method selection changes
No threshold or primary success relabeling
Report original frozen recognition and corrected auxiliary audit separately

additional_generation.scope: Auxiliary assisted32-token generation after the same gold prefix; fixed before any auxiliary model evaluation and independent of primary method selection.
